responsibility: Supplies the AIX 5.3-specific rs6000 target configuration. It extends the generic AIX setup with AIX 5.3 option validation and diagnostics, assembler CPU mapping including native and newer POWER4/5/6/7/8/9 forms, OS-version CPP builtins through _AIX53, updated default processors, and the AIX 5.3 library, link, startfile, and ABI-type definitions, making it the versioned subtarget header that connects rs6000 code generation and driver specs to this newer AIX release.
